messages:
leah: Quick postmortem follow-up: from today's GPU autoscale incident, we need owners for quota increase, scheduler tuning, and headroom alerts. I'll patch a tracker in GH.

sanjay: assigning owners: quota -> ricardo, scheduler -> maya, headroom/runbook -> tim. ricardo can start quota request ticket.

ricardo: filed ticket JIRA-9901 (https://jira.redwood/browse/JIRA-9901). ETA for quota approval ~ 5 business days. @maya can you drop scheduler PR link?

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scheduler/pull/482
- changes: better bin-packing, backpressure threshold tuning
- bench: reduced OOM/eviction events on perf runs

tim: I'll own headroom alerting. Suggest metrics: queue_depth_95, cpu_reserved_pct, free_gpus. I'll add alert runbook.

leah: timeline check — can we have quick wins in 48h? (smaller batch limits + emergency capacity pool)

maya: yes, can ship emergency capacity pool config as a patch today. will open PR and request deploy approval.

ops-bot: deploy request #deploy-1887 opened by maya for branch autoscale-emergency-config

sanjay: reminder: scheduler tuning needs canary on dedicated pool A only, then roll to B.

maya: canary plan in PR description. will coordinate with eng-sre for traffic split.

tim: runbook todo: add "when GPU utilization > 85% for 10m AND pending_queue > 50 for 5m" -> trigger headroom increase, notify #incidents.

ricardo: quota blocker: cloud team asked for utilization report for last 90 days. I can generate; giving ETA EOD tomorrow.

leah: recurring pattern noted: spike at 03:00 UTC correlated with nightly batch jobs. @amir-data any chance to reschedule? :thinking:

amir-data: we can move nightly heavy jobs to 05:00 UTC, will run impact test next Tue.

sanjay: action items summary (short):
- J-1 (ricardo): JIRA-9901 + utilization report by EOD+1
- J-2 (maya): scheduler PR + canary deploy today
- J-3 (tim): runbook + headroom alerts by EOD+2
- J-4 (leah/sanjay): emergency capacity pool config + deploy approval

leah: set weekly 30min sync for tracking until closure, Mondays 09:00 PT

maya: noted. will post PR and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:

tim: I'll add doc links: runbook draft https://go.redwood/runbooks/gpu-headroom-draft

ricardo: utilization report snippet:
```
period: 90d
avg_gpu_util: 61%
p95_util: 89%
peak_days: [2026-03-10, 2026-03-17]
```

leah: thanks all. closing loop: next check-in Monday or earlier if quota approved. reactions: :eyes: :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy autoscale-emergency-config merged and scheduled for canary at 2026-03-24T02:15:00Z
